extraction.notes: Whole page read (page 1); the full survey report it links to was not retrieved. This run's items: MDA-GOV-2024-002-0016 to MDA-GOV-2024-002-0037 (22 items: 2 interventions, 18 metrics, 2 findings; all theme, TECH-DGOV, with TECH-INFRA for the two internet access figures). Alpha items 0001 to 0015 are unchanged; their passages are quoted again here. Left out: the sample description, headings that state the findings (for example "Satisfaction with the quality of e-services is on the rise", "Internet access on the rise"), the sentence on digital skills determining access, the forecast for mobile access, the list of expected benefits, and the general shift of information sources from television to the internet. Doubtful for the analyst (theme_doubtful): the four digital literacy figures (digital skills rule), the two internet access figures (TECH-INFRA materiality) and the information-source figure. Agency summary of its own commissioned survey, run to measure a project it implements; the fieldwork organisation is not named. Not reconciled on the page: 55.3% accessed at least one service electronically against 54.5% online access. No Chapter 2 content.
